title: Minimize Max Distance to Gas Station
summary: Given an array of gas station positions and an integer k, add k new gas stations to minimize the maximum distance between any two adjacent gas stations.
statement: Given an array of gas station positions and an integer k, add k new gas stations to minimize the maximum distance between any two adjacent gas stations. Return the smallest possible maximum distance, with answers within 10^-6 of the actual value being accepted.
constraints: stations is strictly increasing and k is the exact number of additional stations available.
Minimize the largest adjacent distance; answers within 1e-6 are accepted.
reference_solution:
def minimize_maximum_gas_gap(stations,k):
    left=0.0;right=max(b-a for a,b in zip(stations,stations[1:]))
    for _ in range(70):
        middle=(left+right)/2
        needed=sum(int((b-a)/middle) for a,b in zip(stations,stations[1:]))
        if needed>k:left=middle
        else:right=middle
    return right
